bio.text: Yassamin Ansari was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives in January 2025.
Before Congress she was Vice Mayor of Phoenix and, on the Phoenix City Council, the youngest woman ever elected to it.
She is a graduate of Stanford and Cambridge universities.

sources.title: Meet Yassamin
